properties.reason: Missing cart path: the asphalt stub that leaves the Red-tee path at E537836 N4810528 and runs SW past the Gold tee to a squared end at E537793 N4810506.5, about 2.2 m wide. Round 2 corrected the round-1 geometry: the round-1 box was a straight line from the visible SW piece (E537793-810) to the Red-tee path end, but east of E537815 the asphalt curves about 1.5-3.6 m further south. It runs under the tree shadow along N4810516.4 (E537818), N4810519.9 (E537826) and N4810522.9 (E537831). There it is a 2.0-2.5 m band, NDVI 0.01-0.05, neutral grey RGB 60-75, with parallel edges, and it continues into the Red-tee path. The round-1 strip lay on tan dormant grass (NDVI 0.13-0.18). Centreline from per-metre NDVI profiles; E537811-817 (deep shadow) interpolated. [QA round 2, verified]

White tee box as mown in the 2025 photo: a clear ~19 x 8.5 m smooth-cut rectangle (E537882-901, N4810549-561); the model pad (47 m2) is only the NW half, the part on the 2018 LiDAR deck. Hole 11 got new tees on every set in 2023, so the SE half sits ~0.5 m lower in the 2018 DEM than the rebuilt deck. Marker (540 yd) stays on this box.

Gold tee box as mown in the 2025 photo: smooth rectangle E537809.6-818.8 N4810520-526.8 (~62 m2) replacing the 32 m2 C-shaped LiDAR pad; its axis spans ~446-453 yd, so the 451 yd card (now 446) fits on the box.
Part of the old LiDAR White pad outside the tee box mown in the 2025 photo: rough, like the surrounding ground.

Part of the old LiDAR Gold pad outside the tee box mown in the 2025 photo: rough, like the surrounding ground.

Leftover pieces of the 2018 White deck outside the 2023 White box (round-1 override): a 12.5 m2 lobe at E537877-882 N4810551-560 and a 1.2 m2 sliver on the east edge. Leaf-litter false native in the woods south of the 11th fairway (E537521-533 N4810492-497): the 2025 photo shows the same leaf-littered woods floor with trunk shadows all around, no mulch bed. Burn with the surrounding wooded rough. [QA round 2, verified]

Landscaped mulch bed on the mound behind the 11th White tee / left of the 10th green (E537871-894 N4810563.5-577): a clear pink-brown mulch ellipse with a defined rim in the 2025 photo, on a built mound in the LiDAR. The model has native on only its 60 m2 NE ridge; this traces the whole bed (stops north of the small structure at E537884-887 N4810564-566 by the path). [QA round 2, verified]
